notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Zombie.
description:
Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {2}{U}.
Poppet Stitcher triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Zombie you control.
Resolve Mystic Speculation, causing you to scry 3 and returning Mystic Speculation to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {U}.
Repeat.
If you control two or more Zombies as the combo begins, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.
